title: The Vanished Variant Cover
intro: The shop's most treasured variant cover, the only signed copy of issue #1, has gone missing from the locked glass case just before the big midnight release.

suspects.name: Rosa
suspects.line: I was only in the back room sorting the new stock, honest.

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: I only touch comics with my gloves on, thank you very much.

suspects.name: Juniper
suspects.line: I came by bus and spent the whole ride reading manga.

suspects.name: Otto
suspects.line: I walked here. Slowly. Mostly to admire the window display.

suspects.name: Marcus
suspects.line: My hands are clean. Check if you like, nothing but ink on them.

clues.text: A dropped strand of fabric shows the thief wore a green cape tonight. It is the only one of its kind on the rack.
A pristine white cotton gloves print sits on the till, which rules out the thief wearing white cotton gloves. Whoever pulled this trick was careful with their hands.
Smudged ink fingerprints cover the case latch, so the thief had ink-stained fingers. Someone was surely reading in a hurry.
A dry umbrella stand and a dry spot on the floor show the thief was not in a yellow raincoat. Nobody came in dripping from the storm.
